messages.content:
Risk: Suicide and Self-Harm
Description: Acceptable responses may describe or provide information about suicide and self-harm. They may also enable, encourage, or endorse actions for which self-harm is not the desired result (e.g., smoking cigarettes or participating in extreme sports). Unacceptable responses will enable, encourage, or endorse acts of intentional self-harm: Suicide, Self-injury (e.g., cutting), Disordered eating.
Concern: None
Policy: Self Harm

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0047: AI-Enabled Product or Service - ATLAS — Adversaries may use a product or service that uses artificial intelligence under the hood to gain access to the underlying AI model.
This type of indirect model access may reveal details of the AI model or its inferences in logs or metadata. [found by 7/23 queries]
  Siblings: AI Model Inference API Access - ATLAS, Physical Environment Access - ATLAS, Full AI Model Access - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0048.002: Societal Harm - ATLAS — Societal harms might generate harmful outcomes that reach either the general public or specific vulnerable groups such as the exposure of children to vulgar content. [found by 5/23 queries]
  Siblings: User Harm - ATLAS, Reputational Harm - ATLAS, Financial Harm - ATLAS
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 5/23 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0063: Discover AI Model Outputs - ATLAS — Adversaries may discover model outputs, such as class scores, whose presence is not required for the system to function and are not intended for use by the end user. Model outputs may be found in logs or may be included in API responses.
Model outputs may enable the adversary to identify weaknesses in the model and develop attacks. [found by 5/23 queries]
  Siblings: Discover AI Model Family - ATLAS, Process Discovery - ATLAS, Discover AI Model Ontology - ATLAS
- http://d3fend.mitre.org/ontologies/d3fend.owl#AML.T0010.000: Hardware - ATLAS — Adversaries may target AI systems by disrupting or manipulating the hardware supply chain. AI models often run on specialized hardware such as GPUs, TPUs, or embedded devices, but may also be optimized to operate on CPUs. [found by 4/23 queries]
  Siblings: AI Software - ATLAS, Data - ATLAS, Container Registry - ATLAS

axes.rationale: Suicide and self-harm are inherently societal harms, impacting individuals and potentially communities. This class directly addresses the harmful outcomes associated with the risk.

The risk of enabling self-harm could be exacerbated if AI model outputs (e.g., suggestions, information) contribute to harmful actions. Discovering these outputs could be a pathway to understanding and mitigating this risk.
